provenance: Original AI-generated illustrations for this project. User delegated selection and upload. Existing game references informed palette and silhouette; no reference screenshot is shipped. Source PNGs retain generator metadata. No source image edits.

assets.prompt: Production game UI icon for Glide & Grab, an original Roblox floating-island egg heist game. One single shopping basket in three-quarter view, chunky orange-gold plastic with two dark navy handles and a couple of simple square stud impressions, holding one small cream egg with blue spots and a folded royal-blue hang glider wing. Bright modern Roblox simulator inventory illustration: thick near-black navy outer outline, clean cel shaded highlights, few large shapes, crisp readable silhouette, playful toy materials, top-left lighting. Palette orange #FFAC13, cyan #20BDF2, royal blue, warm yellow, outline #102634. Centered square composition, object fills 82 percent of canvas with generous transparent margin. Deliver a clean transparent cutout. No words, letters, prices, logos, watermark, UI frame, scenery, loose sparkles, cast floor shadow or extra basket. Must remain legible as a 48 pixel navigation icon and as a 72 pixel shop-header illustration.
assets.status: Approved on Roblox; loaded and visually reviewed in Studio
